functional_requirements: An organiser can publish an event with a capacity and registration deadline.
An attendee can register while registration is open; if capacity is exhausted, the system adds the attendee to a waiting list.
The system promotes the first waiting attendee when a confirmed registration is cancelled.
non_functional_requirements: Registration confirmation must be returned within 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
Personal data must be accessible only to authorised organisers.
project_description: A web service for publishing events, registering attendees, maintaining waiting lists and notifying users.
project_goal: Allow attendees to register for events and organisers to control capacity.
project_task: Prepare analysis artifacts for an event registration application.
